title.narrative: EU-UNDP Technical Assistance to the Final Beneficiaries of the EIB Early Recovery and Ukraine Recovery Programmes

description.narrative: The contract will support the proper implementation of the European Investment Bank (EIB)¿s Ukraine Recovery Programme (URP) framework loan. In doing so, it will contribute to the recovery of destroyed/damaged critical infrastructure, peace, economic revitalization and reconciliation in the regions of Ukraine affected by Russia¿s war as well as those being under heavy pressure on social services and other infrastructure due to the influx of internally-displaced persons (IDPs).
